# First dataset
```{r arrange and format colummns}

setwd(path)

prior2010 <- read.csv("Prior Lake Ecoli 2002-2010 tabular.csv") %>%
  rename(date = Sample.Date) %>%
  rename(Watzl = Watzl.s) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date, format = "%m/%d/%Y")) 


Expected <- length(which(prior2010[,2:3] == "<1")) +  length(which(prior2010 [,2:3] == "1")) # number of <1 and 1 in all data columns
# also works with random <10 in data

prior2010 <- prior2010 %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      .cols = 2:3,
      .fns = ~ str_replace(string = .x, pattern = "<1", replacement = "1")
    )
  )

# check that all converted correct
length(which(prior2010[,2:3] == "1"))  == Expected # True

# convert to numeric (removes "not tested")
prior2010 <- prior2010 %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      .cols = 2:3,
      .fns = as.numeric
    )
  )


str(prior2010)
summary(prior2010)


# make long
prior2010_long <- prior2010 %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Sandpoint, Watzl),
    names_to = "beach_name",
    values_to = "sample_1")


# rename beaches to match other data  (can't find a tidyverse way to do this)
prior2010_long$beach_name[prior2010_long$beach_name == "Sandpoint"] <-  "Sand Point Beach"
prior2010_long$beach_name[prior2010_long$beach_name == "Watzl"] <-  "Watzl's Beach"

rm(prior2010)


prior2010_long <- as.data.frame(prior2010_long)

```


# Rest of data
```{r load in data}



filepath = "G:/Shared drives/MSP LTER - Public/Q2 - Lakes and Watersheds/Q2.2 - Lakes & Surface Waters/TCMA Lake Research/Research initiatives/Beaches/Received data/City of Prior Lake/spreadsheets/"

setwd(path)

# list of each file


files <- list.files(path = filepath, 
                           pattern = ".xlsx", 
                           all.files = FALSE,  # no hidden files or lock files (ie if something is open in excel)
                           full.names = TRUE    # include file extension
                           )


# create empty data frame to put the data in
pl_raw <- data.frame()

# renaming dictionary for inconsistent column naming below
rename_lookup <- c(date = "sample_date", more_notes = "na")  


for (i in 1:length(files)) {
  
  oneyear <- read_excel(files[i]) # read in one file
  
  numcols <- ncol(oneyear) # get number of columns in dataset
  
  # separate by beach
  sandpoint  <- oneyear %>%
    select(all_of(1:5)) %>%               # choose columnns for this beach
    row_to_names(row_number = 1) %>%      # move row 1 to headers
    janitor::clean_names() %>%            # convert all names to tidy format (no spaces, no caps)
    rename(any_of(rename_lookup)) %>%     # rename columns using lookup above
    filter(!is.na(sample_1))  %>%         # remove empty rows and notes rows
    mutate(beach_name = "Sand Point Beach") %>%    # add column for beach name
    mutate(date = janitor::convert_to_date(date)) # format date
  
  watzl <- oneyear %>%
    select(all_of(7:numcols)) %>%   
    row_to_names(row_number = 1) %>%      
    janitor::clean_names() %>%
    rename(any_of(rename_lookup)) %>% 
    filter(!is.na(sample_1))  %>%                 
    mutate(beach_name = "Watzl's Beach") %>%
    mutate(date = janitor::convert_to_date(date))
  
    oneyear_recombined <- bind_rows(sandpoint, watzl)

    # join to combined df
    pl_raw  <- bind_rows(pl_raw , oneyear_recombined)
}
  


# need to figure out a way to combine the two notes columns into one


```


# combine
```{r convert all values to numeric}


pl <- pl_raw # datafream to manipulate

str(pl)
summary(pl)

# Change values that are "<1" to 1--------

Expected <- length(which(pl[,2:5] == "<1")) +  length(which(pl[,2:5] == "1")) # number of <1 and 1 in all data columns

pl <- pl %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      .cols = 2:5,
      .fns = ~ str_replace(
        string = .x,
        pattern = "<1",
        replacement = "1"
      )
      .cols = 2:5,
      .fns = ~ str_replace(string = .x, pattern = "<1", replacement = "1")
    )
  )

# check that all converted correct
length(which(pl[,2:5] == "1"))  == Expected # True



# convert numeric columns from chr --> num

pl <- pl %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      .cols = 2:5,
      .fns = as.numeric
    )
  )

pl<- pl %>%
  mutate(units = "mpn")

str(pl)
summary(pl)


# add units column
pl$units <- "mpn/100mL"

# add old data to new data
pl <- bind_rows(prior2010_long, pl)



pl <- pl %>%
  select(-average, -geometric_mean)


```

```{r calculate geometric means}
for (i in 1:length(sand$date)) {
  intervalstart <- as.POSIXct(sand$date[i] - 30) # start 30 days before sampling date
  intervalend <-  as.POSIXct(sand$date[i])

  # select all E coli measurements for one day
  oneday <-  sand %>%
    filter(date == intervalend)
  
  # calculate 1 day geometric mean and add it to column in df
  sand$Ecoli_1dGM[i] <- round(geomean(oneday$meas, na.rm = TRUE), digits = 1)
  
  
  # select all E coli measurements in range
  span30d <-  sand %>%
    filter(date >= intervalstart & date <= intervalend)
  
  # calculate 30-day geometric mean and add it to column in df
  sand$Ecoli_30dGM[i] <- round(geomean(span30d$meas, na.rm = TRUE), digits = 1)
}
  

sand <- sand %>%
  select(beach_name, date, Ecoli_1dGM, Ecoli_30dGM) %>%
  distinct()

  intervalend <-  as.POSIXct(watzl$date[i])
```

Read back in early data to calc Geomean
```{r}

pl_early <- read.csv("G:/My Drive/Research/beaches/data/processed/PriorLake1_091725.csv") %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date, format = "%m/%d/%Y"))



# create new column to hold calculated values
pl_early$Ecoli_30dGM <- 0



# separate by beach for calculations------------------------------

sand <- pl_early %>%
  filter(beach_name == "Sand Point Beach")

  
for (i in 1:length(sand$date)) {
  intervalstart <- as.POSIXct(sand$date[i] - 30) # start 30 days before sampling date
  intervalend <-  as.POSIXct(sand$date[i])
  
  # select all E coli measurements in range
  span30d <-  sand %>%
    filter(date >= intervalstart & date <= intervalend)
  
  # calculate 30-day geometric mean and add it to column in df
  sand$Ecoli_30dGM[i] <- round(geomean(span30d$sample_1, na.rm = TRUE), digits = 1)
}
  

sand <- sand %>%
  select(beach_name, date, Ecoli_1dGM, Ecoli_30dGM) %>%
  distinct()




# separate by beach for calculations------------------

watzl <- pl_early %>%
  filter(beach_name == "Watzl's Beach")


for (i in 1:length(watzl$date)) {
  
  intervalstart <- as.POSIXct(watzl$date[i] - 30) # start 30 days before sampling date
  intervalend <-  as.POSIXct(watzl$date[i])
  
  # select all E coli measurements in range
  span30d <-  watzl %>%
    filter(date >= intervalstart & date <= intervalend)
  
  # calculate 30-day geometric mean and add it to column in df
  watzl$Ecoli_30dGM[i] <- round(geomean(span30d$sample_1, na.rm = TRUE), digits = 1)
  
}

watzl <-  watzl %>%
  select(beach_name, date, Ecoli_1dGM, Ecoli_30dGM) %>%
  distinct()




priorlake_early <- rbind(sand, watzl) 

priorlake_early <- priorlake_early[!is.na(priorlake_early$Ecoli_1dGM),] # remove any NAs in data


# add columns to match master dataset--------------------
priorlake_early  <- priorlake_early  %>%
  mutate(
    Ecoli_units = "",
    ClosureYN = "N",
    ClosureReason = NA,
    MonitoringOrg = "PriorLake",
    DOW = "70002600",  # Lower Prior Lake
    units = "mpn"
  )



# find a label beach closures-------------------------------

priorlake_early  <- priorlake_early  %>%
  mutate(
    ClosureYN = if_else(
      condition = Ecoli_1dGM > 1260,
      true = "Y",
      false = "N")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ClosureReason = if_else(
      condition = Ecoli_1dGM > 1260,
      true = "ecoli_1dayGM",
      false = NA)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    ClosureYN = if_else(
      condition = Ecoli_30dGM > 126,
      true = "Y",
      false = "N")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ClosureReason = if_else(
      condition = Ecoli_30dGM > 126,
      true = "ecoli_30dayGM",
      false = NA)
  ) 



write_csv(priorlake_early, file = here("PriorLake1_091725_fixed.csv"))
```
